factors.A: unigrams plus bigrams instead of unigrams
factors.C: sublinear term frequency instead of raw counts
factors.E: binary term-frequency counts; this makes sublinear term frequency inactive
factors.F: norm=None instead of L2-normalized document/query TF-IDF vectors

utility: mean NDCG@10, binary original relevance, log2(rank+1) discounts
shared_code: numpy is np; sklearn/scipy operation names use their standard imports; SelectPercentile and f_classif are from sklearn.feature_selection; RobustScaler is from sklearn.preprocessing. Native fitting and metric boundaries are the same as the paired four-factor source.
options_origin: authored native-library configurations; not generated improvements or mined patches
reference_scope: effects on this fixed finite evaluation cohort, without a population causal claim
condition: paired six-factor variant; same prepared source as the four-factor instance
